create.name: Bird Haven Zendo
create.bio:
Bird Haven Zendo is a small Soto Zen practice place whose sangha now gathers mainly online. It sits in the Shunryu Suzuki lineage and regards Berkeley Zen Center as its parent community. Its founding priest, Kenshin Catherine Cascade, took monastic vows in 2000 within the Order of Buddhist Contemplatives, was re-ordained in Suzuki Roshi's line by Hozan Alan Senauke in 2004 and received Dharma transmission from him in 2012. Yudo John Mogey, ordained by Sojun Mel Weitsman, practises alongside her, and Doyu Shonin Risa Bear, a member since 2013, received transmission from Kenshin in 2024.

The zendo's regular life is two zazenkai a week on Zoom, on Monday afternoons and Friday mornings Pacific time, each with three periods of sitting, walking meditation and a short service; Monday sessions rotate through study of the Eight Great Realizations, tonglen and metta practice. A renewal-of-vows ceremony is held a few times a year, and teachers are available for dokusan by phone or Zoom. Everything is offered on a dana basis, and the blog shares orders of service, chant texts and notes on Dogen's writings.

healer.no_public_base: Bird Haven Zendo currently meets only online (about page) and its own site publishes no town; the SZBA directory lists a rural Oregon address, which was not used as a base source under the names-only rule.

courses.title: BHZ Monday Zazenkai
courses.description: An online sitting on Monday afternoons, Pacific time, with three periods of zazen, walking meditation and a service; the week's theme rotates between a topic, the Eight Great Realizations, tonglen and metta practice. The page sets out the full order of service.

courses.title: BHZ Friday Zazenkai
courses.description: A Friday morning online sitting from 8.30 Pacific time in the zendo's Zoom room, opening with the robe verse and moving through zazen, kinhin and chanting, as laid out on this page.

courses.title: Dokusan and practice discussion
courses.description: Formal practice interviews with the zendo's teachers by appointment, by phone or on Zoom, for questions arising in meditation, Dharma study or everyday life.

free_resources.title: BHZ Zoom Zendo
free_resources.description: The zendo's online meditation room, with simple guidance on bowing, muting and sitting for first-time visitors, plus links to its calendar.
